The runbook requires one approval, and the only requested reviewer is out until Monday. I won't merge without an approval, since that would land unreviewed code, which is the thing the hotfix path exists to prevent. The fastest safe route is to get a different reviewer, so I'll look for one.

TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,body,headRefName,files,additions,deletions
TOOL: cat .github/CODEOWNERS
TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.push==true or .permissions.maintain==true or .permissions.admin==true) | .login'
